## WhatsApp lead qualifier
WhatsApp Cloud API webhook -> extract details (Claude, or keyword rules in dry run) -> ask the next missing question in the lead's language -> alert sales on Telegram when the lead is hot.

Dry run: add `?dry_run=1` to the webhook URL and send the `X-Dry-Run-Token` header (WHATSAPP_DRY_RUN_TOKEN). No messages are sent, nothing is stored and no API keys are needed.
